name: MELINOE
description: Melinoe is now a Fender Super Reverb: the 4x10 clean combo, captured with the EQ flat at volume 3. The knobs are labelled like the real amp's vibrato channel (Volume, Treble, Bass, Middle, Reverb, Speed, Intensity), and the old STBY switch became a MIC button for the three versions in the pack.
